title: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Government (DFAT), managed by Australia Awards in Indonesia
languageRequirement: IELTS 6.5 by the end of pre-departure training (entry minimum not confirmed on official site)
description: Fully funded Masters or PhD study at an Australian university for Indonesian citizens. Covers return air travel, a one-off establishment allowance, full tuition fees and a contribution to living expenses.
requirements: Online application form
Supporting documents listed in the Australia Awards Scholarships Policy Handbook
Targeted categories only: SK PNS, KTP from an equity-target province, or letter confirming disability status
notes: 2027 intake. Must apply for a course in Indonesia's priority fields of study (list for next intake not yet published, so fieldsOfStudy is empty). Min GPA: Masters 2.9, PhD 3.0; equity target groups 2.75. Next intake (2028) is expected to open around Feb 2027.
changeSummary: Added a list of what the scholarship covers.

title: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: LPDP (Government of Indonesia) and Australia Awards in Indonesia (Australian Government)
description: Masters scholarship at an Australian university, jointly offered by LPDP and Australia Awards for Indonesian citizens. Includes a stipend, Overseas Student Health Cover and English training before departure.
requirements: Online application via LPDP
Documents listed in the LPDP-Australia Awards Application Guide (not yet itemised here)
notes: 2027 intake. IELTS figure confirmed in the 2025-intake country profile; re-check for the next intake. People with disability and residents of target areas are encouraged to apply. Benefits list only covers what the official page names; tuition and airfare not yet confirmed.
changeSummary: Added a list of what the scholarship covers.

title: Fulbright Master's Degree Scholarship
provider: AMINEF (American Indonesian Exchange Foundation), funded by the U.S. Government
languageRequirement: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 125 (minimum varies by field)
description: One to two years of Master's study at a U.S. university for Indonesian S1 graduates. Grant of up to USD 52,000 per year for tuition, stipend and health cover, plus flights, visa and settling-in support.
requirements: Indonesian citizen with an S1 degree, GPA at least 3.0
Completed application form with one-page study objective, one-page personal statement and an academic writing sample
English test score less than two years old (TOEFL ITP, TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo)
Three reference letters from an employer or university lecturer
Legalized transcript and diploma, with English translation
Valid ID (KTP or passport)
Curriculum vitae
benefits: Fulbright health benefit (ASPE) and university health insurance
Round-trip international airfare to the U.S. and domestic travel in Indonesia
TOEFL iBT/GRE/GMAT and university application fees
notes: Deadline 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 WIB. Study starts in the fall term of the following year. All fields except medicine involving patient care or clinical contact. No financial support for dependants. Preference for applicants without recent substantial U.S. experience.

title: Fulbright Doctoral Degree (PhD) Scholarship
provider: AMINEF (American Indonesian Exchange Foundation), funded by the U.S. Government
languageRequirement: TOEFL ITP 575, TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 7.0 or Duolingo 135
description: Three years of PhD funding at a U.S. university for Indonesians with an S2 degree who intend to take up or return to an academic position. Grant of up to USD 50,000 per year plus travel and visa support.
requirements: Indonesian citizen with an S2 degree, GPA at least 3.0
Intention to take up or return to an academic position after the degree
Not currently pursuing another degree or holding another scholarship
Completed application form with study objective, personal statement and an academic writing sample
English test score less than two years old
Three reference letters from an employer or university lecturer
Legalized transcript and diploma, with English translation
Valid ID (KTP or passport) and curriculum vitae
benefits: Fulbright health benefit (ASPE) and university health insurance
Round-trip international airfare to the U.S. and domestic travel in Indonesia
Admission test and university application fees
notes: Deadline 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 WIB. Funding for three years. Not open to medicine involving patient care. No U.S. government exchange program in the previous three years. No financial support for dependants.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
languageRequirement: Set by each Swedish master's programme
description: Fully funded Master's study in Sweden for professionals with leadership experience from 34 countries, including Indonesia. Applicants must first apply to an eligible programme through University Admissions in Sweden.
requirements: Apply to an eligible Swedish master's programme via University Admissions by 15 January 2027 and pay the application fee
At least 3,000 hours of work experience before February 2027, from at most three employers
Demonstrated leadership experience
Be liable to pay tuition fees in Sweden
Be admitted to the programme on the first admissions day
benefits: Full tuition fees, paid directly to the university
notes: 2027/28 intake. Two steps: university application 16 Oct 2026 – 15 Jan 2027, then SI scholarship portal 8–24 Feb 2027 (portal closing time not confirmed, apply early). Eligible programmes list published 13 Nov 2026. Does not include insurance or family grants.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship – China-Indonesia Higher Education Program
provider: China Scholarship Council, via the Embassy of China in Indonesia
languageRequirement: HSK 4 for Chinese-taught master's/PhD; IELTS/TOEFL per university for English-taught programmes
description: Bilateral Chinese Government Scholarship for Indonesians, 20 places for undergraduate, master's and doctoral study in China for the 2027/2028 academic year. Full scholarship, international airfare not included.
requirements: Age limits: undergraduate under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40
Online application at campuschina.org with Indonesian agency number 3602
Pre-admission letter from at least one Chinese university
Notarized highest diploma and academic transcripts
Study plan or research proposal (800 words for postgraduates)
Two recommendation letters from professors (postgraduate)
Foreigner Physical Examination Form and non-criminal record certificate
CSCA score report (bachelor's applicants only)
notes: Embassy deadline is 'before 14 February 2027'. International travel is not covered. Benefits follow CSC's standard full scholarship; current stipend rates not stated in the 2027 notice. Results July–August 2027.

title: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları)
provider: Government of Türkiye (YTB – Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities)
languageRequirement: Not required to apply; one-year Turkish language course provided
description: Government of Türkiye scholarship for bachelor's, master's and PhD study, with university placement included. Open to students from all countries.
requirements: Age limits: bachelor's under 21, master's under 30, PhD under 35
Minimum academic score: 70% for bachelor's, 75% for master's and PhD, 90% for medicine, dentistry and pharmacy
Online application on turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
benefits: Flight ticket at the start and end of study
notes: 2026 round (start 2026/27). The general round runs 10 January – 20 February each year; the 2027 round has not been officially announced yet.

title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
languageRequirement: Set by each Hungarian university; Hungarian-taught programmes need B2 Hungarian
description: Hungarian government scholarship for bachelor's, master's and doctoral study at Hungarian universities, for citizens of partner countries including Indonesia.
requirements: Online application at apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu
Nomination by the Indonesian sending partner (may have an earlier internal deadline)
Only programmes supported by the Hungary-Indonesia cooperation agreement
Medical certificate on the official form
benefits: Free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 monthly housing contribution
Medical care under Hungarian law plus supplementary insurance up to HUF 65,000 per year
notes: 2026/27 round. Stipend figures come from the 2024/25 provisions notice and may have changed. The 2027/28 call has not been published yet; previous deadlines were mid-January.

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan, via the Embassy of Japan in Indonesia
languageRequirement: Japanese or English, depending on the programme
description: Japanese government scholarship for graduate study or research at a Japanese university, through embassy recommendation. Covers tuition, a monthly allowance and airfare.
requirements: Born on or after 2 April 1992 (under 35)
Eligible for a master's or doctoral programme at a Japanese graduate school
Application forms, certificate of health and recommendation letter submitted to the Embassy of Japan, not to MEXT
First screening by the embassy between May and July
benefits: Tuition, admission and entrance exam fees exempted
Regional supplement of ¥2,000–3,000 per month in designated areas
notes: 2027 intake (April or September/October 2027). The 22 April 2026 Indonesia embassy deadline comes from a secondary source and needs checking on id.emb-japan.go.jp. The 2028 round is expected to open around April 2027.

title: LPDP SHARE Scholarship (Social, Humanities, Art, Religious Studies, Education)
provider: LPDP (Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan), Ministry of Finance of Indonesia
languageRequirement: Overseas: Master's IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80, Doctoral IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 (lower for affirmation categories; waived with unconditional LoA)
description: Indonesian government scholarship for Master's (up to 24 months) or Doctoral (up to 48 months) study in social, humanities, arts, religious and education fields, at home or abroad.
requirements: Minimum GPA: Master's 3.00, Doctoral 3.25 (general category)
Maximum age on 31 December: Master's 35, Doctoral 40 (general category)
English certificate valid within two years, unless holding an unconditional LoA
Domestic study: BAN-PT A/Unggul accredited programme
benefits: International seminar and journal publication funding
notes: 2026 batch 2. Final results 30 November 2026; study starts from 1 January 2027. GPA, age and language rules differ for CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI, Papua, affirmation regions, low-income and disability categories. The 2027 batch 1 schedule is not out yet.

title: LPDP STEM Strategic Industries Scholarship
provider: LPDP (Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan), Ministry of Finance of Indonesia
languageRequirement: Overseas Master's: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 or Duolingo 120 (waived with unconditional LoA)
description: Indonesian government scholarship for Master's and Doctoral study in STEM fields for strategic industries, at home or abroad. LPDP reserves at least 80% of awards for STEM fields.
requirements: Minimum GPA: Master's 3.00, Doctoral 3.25 (full funding)
English certificate valid within two years, unless holding an unconditional LoA
Online application on the LPDP portal
notes: 2026 batch 2, same schedule as other LPDP programmes (results 30 November 2026). The official requirements page is titled batch 1 and mixes full and partial schemes; check figures against the batch 2 guide. Benefits assumed to match LPDP's standard full-scheme funding components.

title: Chevening Scholarships
provider: UK Government (Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
description: Fully funded one-year master's degree at a UK university for future leaders with work experience.
requirements: At least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience after the undergraduate degree
Apply to three different eligible UK master's courses
Return to home country for at least two years after the scholarship
Unconditional offer from a UK university by 8 July 2027
benefits: Monthly living allowance (rate depends on studying inside or outside London)
Up to £75 for TB testing if required
notes: 2027/28 round, now closed. Deadline date taken from other countries' 2027/28 announcements (6 Oct 2026, 11:00 UTC); confirm for Indonesia. Interviews March–April 2027, results from mid-June 2027. No provision for dependants. Next round usually opens in August.
